TEXT:
After chasing Saori in a panic, I found her next to 
the playground with her back turned, almost like 
she was hiding.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What's the matter? You just suddenly...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Kyo-Kyosuke-san...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Why did you run off like that?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...I'm sorry.
Crap.
She's already apologizing right off the bat.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm not blaming you for anything.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: If it's alright, could you let me know why?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: U-Um...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: You're not going to ask about anything...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, I am curious about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
However, if you're not comfortable speaking about 
it, I won't ask.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
What do you wanna do? Should we just call it a 
day?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: N-No... that won't be necessary.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: U-Ugh... Kyousuke-san...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I truly am sorry...
Saori kept bowing vigorously.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Um... okay. At any rate, you don't need to apologize. 
It's not like you did anything wrong.

When I said that, Saori finally stopped and looked 
up at me.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: U-Um... promise me you won't laugh?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I-It may be a bit too late for this, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
I-It's just, I'm still not used to going outside like 
this...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
I-I came here today after mustering what little 
strength I had...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
My usual self is a very, very timid and shy... 
sheltered young lady....
Don't say that about yourself.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, I gathered that much.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hold on. You mean... you run away out of shyness?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...Yes.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I-I see...
That's beyond my expectations...
To think she was really this shy a person...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Just from calling you on the phone earlier, I 
thought I was about to die...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Even the act of coming here, I don't how many 
times I've thought about running back home...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You should just come as Bajeena.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You can speak normally in that getup, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Y-Yes... that is true, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: G-Geez... Kyousuke-san, you idiot.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: D-Don't pout.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...I am not pouting.
You're so pouting.

Now I get it, this is Saori's "true" self, stronger than 
her Bajeena persona.
Saori Bajeena... If it's that extremely "close" friend...
...She'd never pout like this.
Meaning...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
...I see. Coming here dressed like this... there's a 
special reason behind it.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...Yes.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I see.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
So, you endured it all and came here, dressed like 
this.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...Yes.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Today... and from now on,

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I want to show you my true self.
